en:
I noticed that Miu seems to have shut
herself inside the computer room.
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Keebo for a while?

I-I'm not jealous of the computer.
That...would be ridiculous, of course.

I just wonder if it has something to do with
this other world she mentioned...
<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo and I grew a little closer today.
